description: This Java class provides helper methods for applying tenant-specific trace sampling configurations, including retrieving and applying sampling priorities to tracing spans based on tenant configuration.

classes.name: TenantTraceSamplingHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing tenant-specific trace sampling configurations, including retrieving and applying sampling priorities to tracing spans.

methods.name: getTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Retrieves the trace sampling priority configured for a given tenant object with auth ID.

methods.name: applyTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Applies the tenant's trace sampling priority to a given tracing span.

methods.name: getSamplingMode
methods.description: Retrieves the sampling mode for a tenant based on its tracing configuration.

methods.name: getSamplingPriority
methods.description: Determines the sampling priority value based on the sampling mode.
